concepts.name: Types of Iron Ore and Their Grade Classification
key_dimensions: Four principal types: Magnetite, Hematite, Limonite, Siderite — iron content comparison

concepts.name: Andhra Pradesh and Telangana Iron Ore Deposits

concepts.name: Rajasthan and Central India Iron Ore Deposits

concepts.name: NMDC and Public Sector Iron Ore Mining
